title: Competence-Aware Orchestration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 面向大语言模型多智能体系统的胜任力感知编排

paragraphs.en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing complex reasoning through role specialization and collaboration, yet a key challenge remains: how can collaboration be adapted to a backbone’s competence on the current query? This problem matters because more collaboration is not always better—richer coordination may help on difficult cases, but it also incurs additional token cost and redundant interactions. We propose a two-stage competence-aware framework for automatic MAS orchestration. It first models the LLM backbone’s task-conditioned competence for the current query, and then uses this signal to adapt role activation and the communication graph. Across six benchmarks, our method achieves an average score of 93.81%. Experiments with six LLM backbones of varying competence levels further show that our method adjusts collaboration according to the inferred competence: for higher-competence backbones, it improves average accuracy from 87.22 to 89.97 while reducing token cost by 36.26%; for lower-competence backbones, it yields a further average gain of 4.58 points over existing methods. The same trend also holds on unseen backbones.

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have greatly expanded the use of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) for reasoning, code generation, and complex problem solving ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Related progress in prompting, search, self-refinement, ensembling, and text-based optimization has further improved LLM reasoning and adaptation ( Nori et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) . By assigning specialized roles and coordinating their interactions, LLM-based MAS can outperform direct single-agent reasoning ( Du et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . However, their effectiveness depends critically on collaboration topology and communication pattern: different tasks, and even different instances, may benefit from different forms and scales of collaboration ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Yue et al., 2025 ; Dang et al., 2026 ) . Moreover, more collaboration is not always better: richer role specialization and denser communication may help on difficult cases, but also introduce additional token cost, latency, and redundant interactions ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . This motivates a competence-aware perspective on automatic MAS construction: How can collaboration be adapted to a backbone’s competence on the current query?

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have moved from manually designed pipelines and hand-crafted role-based collaboration patterns ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) to frameworks that automatically optimize or dynamically generate multi-agent structures ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025d ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yue et al., 2025 ; Dang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . By generating role configurations and communication topologies from task descriptions, query content, candidate roles, or runtime feedback, these methods make MAS increasingly task-aware and adaptive ( Zhang et al., 2025d ; Dang et al., 2026 ) . Yet the main focus has been on organizing agent collaboration around task semantics, while relatively less attention has been paid to explicitly conditioning its scale and structure on the backbone’s competence for the current query. We argue that the utility of collaboration is not fixed: it depends on the backbone’s standalone capability, the difficulty of the query, and the coordination overhead introduced by the system. When the backbone’s standalone competence is high on a query, extra roles and intensive communication may add cost with little benefit ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025b ) ; in contrast, weaker backbones or harder queries may benefit substantially from richer coordination and verification. This pattern also appears in broader agentic benchmarks ( Qian et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . Motivated by these observations, we aim to adapt both role participation and communication structure to the backbone’s task-conditioned competence .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究已从手动设计的流程和规范设计的基于角色的协作模式（Hong et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2024；Du et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024）转向能够自动优化或动态生成多智能体结构的框架（Liu et al., 2023；Zhuge et al., 2024；Hu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025d；Zhang et al., 2025c；Zhang et al., 2025a；Yue et al., 2025；Dang et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2025a）。 通过根据任务描述、查询内容、候选角色或运行时反馈生成角色配置和通信拓扑，这些方法使多智能体系统（MAS）能够更紧密地适应任务需求并具备更强的适应性（Zhang et al., 2025d；Dang et al., 2026）。 然而，研究的主要焦点一直集中在围绕任务语义组织智能体的协作上，而相对较少关注如何根据基础模型对当前查询的能力水平，明确调整协作的规模和结构。 我们认为协作的效用并非固定不变：它取决于基础模型的独立能力、查询的难度以及系统引入的协调开销。 当基础模型在某一查询任务上的独立能力较强时，增加额外角色和密集通信可能会带来成本上升而收益有限（Zhang et al., 2025b；Wang et al., 2025b）；相反，能力较弱的基础模型或更复杂的查询则可能从更丰富的协调与验证机制中获益显著。 这种模式也出现在更广泛的多智能体基准测试中（Qian et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2025）。 基于这些观察，我们的目标是使角色参与和通信结构都能根据基础模型在特定任务上的能力水平进行动态调整。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献可总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We design a competence modeling mechanism that combines a reusable backbone capability fingerprint with query-specific task information to derive a backbone-aware, query-conditioned competence representation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种能力建模机制，该机制将可重用的骨干能力指纹与查询特定的任务信息相结合，以推导出一种感知骨干、条件于查询的能力表示。

paragraphs.en: We develop a competence-aware orchestration method that uses this representation to configure the multi-agent structure at two levels—role activation and communication graph generation—adapting team composition and coordination topology to both the backbone and the current query.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种能力感知式编排方法，该方法利用这种表示来在两个层级上配置多智能体结构——角色激活和通信图生成，从而根据主干结构和当前查询动态调整团队组成与协作拓扑。

paragraphs.en: Experiments across multiple benchmarks and backbones show that our method improves overall performance, reduces collaboration token usage on strong backbones, and brings larger gains on weaker backbones, with the same trend also observed on unseen backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 在多个基准和基础模型上进行的实验表明，我们的方法提升了整体性能，在强大的基础模型上减少了协作标记的使用，并在较弱的模型上带来了更大的提升；这一趋势在未见过的基础模型上也同样存在。

paragraphs.en: Early LLM-based multi-agent systems mainly relied on manually designed collaboration templates, including sequential pipelines and debate-style communication Du et al. (2024) . Meanwhile, reasoning can also be improved within a single model through methods such as chain-of-thought Wei et al. (2022) and self-consistency Wang et al. (2022) . To reduce manual engineering in multi-agent systems, subsequent work began to automate structure design, including workflow optimization methods such as AFlow Zhang et al. (2025d) and DSPy Khattab et al. (2024) , as well as graph-based approaches such as GPTSwarm Zhuge et al. (2024) , MacNet Qian et al. (2025) , AgentPrune Zhang et al. (2025b) , and AgentDropout Wang et al. (2025b) . These methods improve system design by searching, optimizing, or pruning collaboration structures before deployment. However, whether hand-crafted or automatically optimized, they remain largely input-independent and follow a learn once, deploy many paradigm.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统主要依赖人工设计的协作模板，包括顺序式流程链和辩论式通信 Du et al. (2024) 。与此同时，通过思维链 Wei et al. (2022) 和自我一致性 Wang et al. (2022) 等方法，也可以在单个模型内部提升推理能力。为了减少多智能体系统中的人工工程投入，后续研究开始尝试自动化结构的设计，包括 AFlow Zhang et al. (2025d) 和 DSPy Khattab et al. (2024) 等工作流优化方法，以及 GPTSwarm Zhuge et al. (2024)、MacNet Qian et al. (2025)、AgentPrune Zhang et al. (2025b) 和 AgentDropout Wang et al. (2025b) 等基于图的方法。这些方法通过在部署前搜索、优化或剪枝协作结构，从而改进系统的设计。然而，无论是人工设计的还是自动优化的方案，它们在很大程度上仍然与输入无关，并遵循“一次学习，多次部署”的模式。

paragraphs.en: More recent studies move beyond static structures and dynamically organize collaboration at inference time. Rather than reusing one fixed design, these methods instantiate or route agent interaction according to the current query or runtime setting. Representative examples include G-Designer , which generates query-specific communication graphs Zhang et al. (2025c) ; MasRouter , which routes topology, roles, and models Yue et al. (2025) ; and MaAS , Puppeteer , CARD , and MaAS2 , which dynamically orchestrate agent workflows under different settings Zhang et al. (2025a) ; Dang et al. (2026) ; Wu et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2025a) . This line of work makes multi-agent systems more responsive to instance-level variation. However, existing methods mainly adapt collaboration to task semantics or runtime context, with limited explicit modeling of the backbone’s query-specific competence. Our work uses task-conditioned competence as a signal for adapting role participation and communication.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究已超越静态结构，在推理阶段动态组织协作。 这些方法并非重复使用单一固定设计，而是根据当前查询或运行时设置来实例化或引导智能体之间的交互。 代表性示例包括 G-Designer，它能生成针对特定查询的通信图 Zhang et al. (2025c)；MasRouter，它能路由拓扑结构、角色和模型 Yue et al. (2025)；以及 MaAS、Puppeteer、CARD 和 MaAS2，它们能在不同设置下动态协调智能体的工作流程 Zhang et al. (2025a)；Dang et al. (2026)；Wu et al. (2026)；Wang et al. (2025a)。 这一系列研究使多智能体系统能更灵活地响应实例层面的变化。 然而，现有方法主要根据任务语义或运行时上下文调整协作，而对主干架构的查询特定能力缺乏明确的建模。 我们的研究将任务相关的特定能力作为信号，用于调整角色参与和通信方式。

sents.en: However, existing methods mainly adapt collaboration to task semantics or runtime context, with limited explicit modeling of the backbone’s query-specific competence.
sents.zh: 然而，现有方法主要根据任务语义或运行时上下文调整协作，而对主干架构的查询特定能力缺乏明确的建模。

sents.en: Our work uses task-conditioned competence as a signal for adapting role participation and communication.
sents.zh: 我们的研究将任务相关的特定能力作为信号，用于调整角色参与和通信方式。

paragraphs.en: Our method follows a two-stage competence-aware orchestration pipeline. In Stage I, we learn a task-conditioned competence representation from a reusable backbone capability fingerprint and query information. In Stage II, we use this representation to adapt the multi-agent structure at two levels: role activation and communication graph construction.

paragraphs.en: To support downstream query-level competence modeling, we precompute a reusable capability fingerprint for each LLM backbone using a fixed probe set 𝒫 \mathcal{P} . The probes are shared across backbones, organized by capability domain, and ordered within each domain by anchor-calibrated difficulty, yielding a common easy-to-hard scale for direct comparison. Note that this fingerprinting step is performed only once for each backbone: after a backbone M M is first evaluated on 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , its fingerprint V m V_{m} can be reused in all subsequent queries.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持下游查询级别的胜任力建模，我们使用固定的探针集合 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 为每个 LLM 主干模型预计算一个可重用的能力指纹。 这些探针在所有主干模型中共享，按能力领域进行组织，并在每个领域内根据通过锚点校准的难度进行排序，从而形成一个通用的从易到难的标尺，便于直接比较。 需要注意的是，对于每个主干模型，这个指纹生成步骤只需执行一次：在首次对主干模型 M M 使用 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 进行评估后，其指纹 V m V_{m} 即可在所有后续查询中重复使用。

paragraphs.en: Following prior work ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) , we compare our method with three groups of baselines. The first group consists of single-agent methods , including Chain-of-Thought (CoT) ( Wei et al., 2022 ) and Self-Consistency ( Wang et al., 2022 ) . The second group includes multi-agent systems with fixed collaboration patterns , such as Chain, Tree, Complete Graph, and Random Graph ( Qian et al., 2025 ) , as well as debate-based interaction instantiated by LLM-Debate ( Du et al., 2024 ) . The third group covers multi-agent methods with dynamic or optimized structures , including AgentPrune ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , AgentDropout ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , MasRouter ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , CARD ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , and G-Designer ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) .

paragraphs.en: We access GPT models via the OpenAI API, primarily using gpt-4o-2024-08-06 (GPT-4o) as the target backbone. Unless otherwise specified, all LLM calls in evaluation use a decoding temperature of 0. For multi-agent methods, we adopt explicit agent profiling with a predefined pool of textual role descriptions, following classical configurations in prior LLM-based MAS work ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2023 ) . We additionally include a summarizer agent to aggregate the dialogue history and produce the final answer. Both task queries and role descriptions are encoded using bge-small-en-v1.5 ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) , yielding 384-dimensional embeddings. We train Task-Conditioned Competence Modeling, Role Activation, and Graph-based MAS Generation sequentially offline, keeping the other modules frozen at each stage. Deployment reuses the trained model without further parameter updates. For training the graph-generation module, following Zhang et al. (2025c) , we use 40 queries from each dataset for training. We use dataset-specific training and evaluation splits; their definitions and the construction of capability fingerprints and supervision targets are detailed in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: On performance-oriented backbones, our method maintains strong performance with substantially lower collaboration cost. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we study how to adapt multi-agent collaboration to a backbone’s competence on the current query . We propose a competence-aware framework that learns a task-conditioned representation under success-rate supervision and uses it to guide role activation and communication topology. Experiments across six benchmarks and multiple LLM backbones show that our method improves performance, reduces collaboration cost on stronger backbones, and yields larger gains on weaker ones, with the same trend also observed on unseen backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了如何将多智能体协作适配到当前查询上主干模型的能力水平。 我们提出了一种能力感知框架，该框架在成功率监督下学习任务相关的表示，并利用其指导角色激活和通信拓扑结构。 在六个基准测试和多种大语言模型主干上的实验表明，我们的方法提升了性能，在更强主干上降低了协作成本，在较弱主干上实现了更大的增益，且未见过的主干也呈现出相同趋势。

paragraphs.en: The goal of task-conditioned competence modeling is to make the fused representation capture how competent a given LLM backbone is expected to be on the current query. Since such query-level competence is not directly annotated, we construct a proxy supervision signal from empirical task performance. The intuition is straightforward: if a backbone succeeds more frequently on a query across repeated trials, it should be regarded as more competent on that query; conversely, a lower success rate indicates lower competence.
paragraphs.zh: 任务条件能力建模的目标是，使融合后的表示能够捕捉到某个给定的 LLM 主干模型在当前查询上预期的能力水平。 由于这种查询层面的能力并未直接标注，我们基于实际的任务表现构建了一个代理监督信号。 其基本原理很简单：如果某个主干模型在多次尝试中更频繁地成功完成某项查询，那么它在该查询上的能力就应被视为更强；反之，成功率较低则表明其能力较弱。
